newsitem.title: USA: China seen reselling 15,000 tonnes soyoil - trade.
newsitem.headline: China seen reselling 15,000 tonnes soyoil - trade.

text.p: Indications are that China recently resold 15,000 tonnes of South American soyoil, several U.S. exporters and traders said.

"That is correct. It's South American soyoil. They are just taking the stuff they bought at $508 to $510 (per tonne) and selling it at around $515. They are making five to six dollars a tonne," he said.
The deal was done to take advantage of the market's current high prices, dealers said.
"I can't confirm it but it sounds reasonable," a U.S. exporter said.
"They (Chinese dealers) wanted to put some money in their pockets," he said.
The soyoil position that was said to be resold was parceled into three 5,000-tonne positions for shipment during May, June and July, exporters said.
One exporter noted the sale was last Friday and on Monday.
